title: MED+250 Rwanda marketplace regulatory approval
summary: Owner-ready approval record for the exact pharmacy-only, information-first marketplace model. Official-source review is documented, but RICA licensing, Rwanda FDA catalogue and advertising clearance, regulated-product scope, privacy compliance and accountable legal signature remain unresolved.

checks.name: Exact production marketplace model documented
checks.detail: The review brief records the pharmacy-only seller model, central catalogue and indicative pricing, private availability requests, nearby-priority and national-fallback routing, optional WhatsApp completion, prescription controls and absence of platform payment custody.

checks.name: RICA e-commerce and online-intermediary classification
checks.detail: The accountable owner has not yet retained the applicable RICA licence or authoritative written determination for the exact MED+250 model under Law No. 011/2026.

checks.name: RICA transitional compliance deadline
checks.detail: The legal owner must confirm and complete the Article 73 conformity plan within the period of no more than six months from the law's 4 March 2026 publication.

checks.name: Rwanda FDA catalogue and advertising determination
checks.detail: No written Rwanda FDA determination or clearance has been retained for the exact public catalogue, search, category, product-page, indicative-price, image, metadata, sitemap and availability-request presentation.

checks.name: Regulated product registration and market status
checks.detail: Medicine source controls are documented, but the legal owner has not approved the complete medicine scope or established Rwanda registration and lawful market-status evidence for every regulated consumer product.

checks.name: Licensed pharmacy and professional dispensing conditions
checks.detail: The pharmacy-only boundary is implemented, but the owner must approve current licence checks, authorised-person requirements, prescription classification, delivery restrictions, controlled-product exclusions, recall handling and final pharmacist responsibility.

checks.name: Personal data and sensitive health-data compliance
checks.detail: Controller and processor registration, role allocation, data protection impact assessment, lawful bases, processor contracts, outside-Rwanda storage and transfer authority, rights handling, breach procedure and final privacy contacts have not been approved.

checks.name: Consumer and intermediary disclosures
checks.detail: Core central-price, pharmacy-seller, availability-request and no-payment wording is present, but the owner must approve the complete enterprise identity, complaints, after-sales, seller disclosure, rules of procedure, takedown and consumer-rights information.

checks.name: Source reuse and product image rights
checks.detail: The separate data-reuse gate remains pending, including raw source retention and permission issues. Amazon is limited to taxonomy and product-reference research, Amazon prices are absent, and external image rights still require source-level approval.

checks.name: Named legal owner decision and signature
checks.detail: The accountable legal and compliance owner must record the approved legal entity, regulatory references, permitted product and pharmacy scope, conditions, exclusions, change triggers, named escalation owners and signed decision.

completion_instructions: Have qualified Rwanda legal and compliance counsel verify the current official sources, amendments, application procedures and exact classification of the implemented marketplace.
Obtain and retain the applicable RICA licence or an authoritative written determination for the exact model, and complete every required intermediary disclosure and content-removal procedure.

Obtain and retain the Rwanda FDA determination or clearance required for the exact catalogue and public presentation, including the approved product scope, format, reference numbers, validity periods and change-control conditions.
Approve only products and pharmacies supported by current Rwanda registration, market-status, premises-licence, authorised-person, prescription, delivery, recall and professional-dispensing evidence.

Complete controller and processor registration, the data protection impact assessment, legal-basis and transfer decisions, processor contracts, retention approval, privacy contacts, rights procedure and breach response.
Resolve the separate data-reuse and product-image rights blockers or remove the affected derived data before signing.
Confirm the recorded review-brief SHA-256 still matches docs/launch/RWANDA_REGULATORY_REVIEW_BRIEF.md.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed artifact strictly, record its exact SHA-256 digest in data/launch-evidence.json, and confirm the gate only after the full registry validates.
